This baseline helps prevent the use of unauthorized local AI agents such as OpenClaw by configuring device settings that disrupt commonly used execution paths. Default settings focus on reducing OpenClaw usage through targeted protections with limited impact to typical device functionality. These settings may not fully block all OpenClaw execution paths. The baseline also includes optional controls that restrict broader runtime environments (for example, Node.js or WSL) which may be leveraged by local agents. These optional settings are disabled by default due to their potential impact on legitimate workloads.
